narration: First Majestic Silver operates several mines primarily located in Mexico. Investing in First Majestic means you’re participating in the silver supply chain. Physical silver, conversely, can serve as a hedge against inflation and economic instability. Silver tends to maintain its value during periods of market turmoil.
